title: Nerkin (copper) hud
description: This resource pack transforms Minecraft's default interface into a copper-themed version while preserving the game's original style.
body:
This resource pack transforms Minecraft's default interface into an attractive copper-themed design. The changes affect the hotbar, menus, inventory, and much more. The resource pack is designed in a vanilla style with a copper theme. Enjoy playing with this resource pack! :)

This resource pack was created for the YouTuber [Nerkin](https://www.youtube.com/@Nerkin).
